item.title: EplayerX 1.2.4
item.description:
## 更新日志
- 改进字幕选择与记忆，优先恢复已保存的内嵌、外挂和插件字幕选择，避免被默认关闭字幕设置覆盖。 - 优化云盘媒体库与刮削任务列表的更新，保持任务选择状态。 - 改善播放快捷键、全屏交互以及剧集资源信息展示。 - 改进媒体库、社区内容同步和未观看提醒的稳定性。 - 完善越南语及其他语言的界面文案。
需要 macOS 12.0 或更高版本，请按 Mac 芯片选择 Apple Silicon 或 Intel 安装包。
## What's New
- Improved subtitle selection and memory: saved embedded, external, and plugin subtitle choices take priority over the default subtitles-off setting. - Refined cloud library and metadata task updates while preserving the selected task. - Improved playback shortcuts, fullscreen interactions, and episode resource information. - Improved reliability of media libraries, community sync, and unwatched reminders. - Refined Vietnamese and other interface translations.
Requires macOS 12.0 or later. Choose the Apple Silicon or Intel download for your Mac.
